vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
使目标的被动技能暂时失效
移除目标身上可被强驱散的效果（含多数眩晕）
降低目标护甲
让普通攻击附带额外效果：减甲、减速、减疗、烧蓝、额外伤害、中毒、降低属性等；有概率触发或只强化下一次攻击也算。单纯提高攻击力、攻速，以及吸血、暴击、分裂弹射归各自词条
使敌方单位的攻击有概率落空
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
技能或物品用一次消耗一点；只决定数值或层数的不算
技能能缩短技能或物品的冷却；A杖或魔晶只降低技能自身冷却的不记，从字段读
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
受到攻击或伤害时触发的反击伤害：按比例返还所受伤害、固定值反击，或受伤触发的范围伤害（如半人马·反伤、斧王·反击螺旋、钢毛后背）；攻击者不一定被打到也算，记条件
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
提供额外金钱或经验；只是正常赏金不算
自身有概率使敌方攻击落空
飞行移动，能越过地形
提供目标或区域的视野
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
让目标受到更多物理伤害或全部伤害（只加深魔法的归上一项）
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
减少目标的法力值
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
降低移动速度或攻击速度
提高技能造成的伤害
把指向技能反弹给施法者
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
召唤有血量的单位（可控或不可控都算），以及夺取已有单位的控制权；按受攻击次数计算的单位和死亡守卫不算
能摧毁树木

objects.subject: nyx_assassin_impale
objects.description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位受到伤害，然后被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕。
objects.description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%，最远作用距离为%length%。
穿刺不会被林肯法球格挡。

objects.subject: nyx_assassin_jolt
objects.description_zh: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去%damage_echo_duration%秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。
objects.description_en: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last %damage_echo_duration%s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.

objects.subject: nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace
objects.description_zh:
激活状态下，尖刺外壳可以反弹并无效化司夜刺客受到的伤害（每个攻击者最多作用一次），同时眩晕攻击者。激活尖刺外壳不会打破复仇的隐身状态。

钻地状态下尖刺外壳施放后将立刻眩晕周围的敌人。
objects.description_en:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
notes_zh: 反弹的伤害与司夜刺客本应受到的实际伤害相同。
尖刺外壳只有在受到玩家控制来源的伤害后会反弹。
反弹的伤害与司夜刺客受到的伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

objects.subject: nyx_assassin_burrow
objects.description_zh: 司夜刺客经过短时间的掘地后钻入地下。钻地后尖刺外壳一施放就会直接眩晕附近所有敌人，神智爆裂和穿刺的施法距离提升，穿刺的冷却时间减少。钻地后司夜刺客固定在原地，无法攻击，并且是隐身状态。同时司夜刺客受到的所有伤害都会降低。
objects.description_en: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
notes_zh: 施放复仇将取消钻地状态。

objects.subject: nyx_assassin_neuro_sting
objects.description_zh: 司夜刺客对敌人造成伤害还会燃烧造成伤害一定百分比的魔法。
objects.description_en: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

objects.subject: nyx_assassin_vendetta
objects.description_zh: 司夜刺客进入隐身状态并获得移动速度加成。如果司夜刺客以攻击打破隐身，当次攻击将造成超高额外伤害，并对目标施加破坏效果。司夜刺客当次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且攻击动作加快%attack_animation_bonus%%%。
objects.description_en: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has %attack_range_bonus% additional attack range and a %attack_animation_bonus%%% faster attack animation for this attack.
notes_zh: 如果在隐身期间使用了技能，或者隐身时间结束，额外伤害的效果将会消失。
会在造成额外伤害前施加破坏效果。

shard.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。在复仇的最初%free_pathing_duration%秒内，司夜刺客为极速状态，并且移动无视地形。
shard.en: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. For the first %free_pathing_duration%s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.

objects.subject: naga_siren_mirror_image
objects.description_zh:
制造多个受娜迦海妖控制的镜像。

驱散类型：弱驱散
objects.description_en:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 娜迦海妖在施法时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以用来躲避眩晕和伤害。
施放后，将会移除娜迦海妖身上大部分效果。
施放时现有的镜像幻象将被摧毁。

objects.subject: naga_siren_ensnare
objects.description_zh: 打断目标的动作并将其困在原地，使其无法移动或闪烁。可以对海妖之歌作用下的单位施放。
objects.description_en: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.

scepter.zh: 提升施法距离和弹道速度。诱捕可以对减益免疫单位施放并且生效。诱捕会施加破坏效果。
scepter.en: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

objects.subject: naga_siren_rip_tide
objects.description_zh: 娜迦海妖和她的幻象每经过%hits%次攻击后就会对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的护甲，持续%duration%秒。
objects.description_en: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for %duration% seconds every %hits% attacks.
notes_zh: 使用激流不会打断持续施法。

objects.subject: naga_siren_eelskin
objects.description_zh: 娜迦海妖拥有闪避加成，%radius%内每增加一个娜迦海妖都会提升。
objects.description_en: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within %radius% radius.

objects.subject: keeper_of_the_light_illuminate
objects.description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导光的能量，持续施法的时间越长，威力越大。释放后，光波沿直线向前发出，造成伤害并获得沿途的视野。
objects.description_en: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
notes_zh: 在持续施法期间获得的视野不断增大。

objects.subject: keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light
objects.description_zh: 一道致盲之光在目标区域闪现，把区域内的单位击退到区域边缘，并造成致盲，使他们的部分攻击不能命中。最短击退距离是在%knockback_duration%秒内击退%knockback_distance%距离。
objects.description_en: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is %knockback_distance% range over %knockback_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 落地后受作用单位将摧毁150范围内的树木。

objects.subject: keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic
objects.description_zh: 恢复目标单位的魔法值，并减少所有冷却中基础技能（非大招）的冷却时间。对自身使用时效果提升%self_bonus%%%。
objects.description_en: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is %self_bonus%%% more effective when used on himself.
notes_zh: 查克拉魔法无法减少终极技能的冷却时间。

objects.subject: keeper_of_the_light_radiant_bind
objects.description_zh: 削弱一个敌人的魔法抗性，并施加减速效果，目标移动的距离越长，减速效果越大。
objects.description_en: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.

objects.subject: keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp
objects.description_zh: 在目标区域召唤幻火。幻火交替闪亮和闪灭。闪亮时蛊惑敌人靠近，并造成伤害。
objects.description_en: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
notes_zh: 幻火会对作用范围内所有敌人施加朝其牵引的效果，该牵引效果不会打断。

objects.subject: keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form
objects.description_zh: 伊扎洛暂时使身体发光，获得施法距离加成，提升光明速度的移速加成，并且冲击波将由一个单独的灵魂施法，可以治疗友军。
objects.description_en: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.

shard.zh: 提升冲击波的治疗效果。

objects.subject: wisp_tether
objects.description_zh: 将艾欧和一个友方单位连接在一起，提高双方的移动速度。当艾欧回复生命或魔法时，连在一起的友军将获得一部分回复效果。距离过远时连接将会断开，也可以主动断开连接。羁绊会减速触碰到的敌人。
objects.description_en: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
notes_zh: 如果羁绊的目标距离艾欧700码以外，艾欧将链接目标并将自己向目标牵引（牵引后相距300码）。
被羁绊连接的单位回复速度相比更快，艾欧满血时也能回复。
艾欧的移动速度与羁绊目标一致。

shard.zh: 羁绊会对触碰到的敌人造成伤害。艾欧会回复%damage_to_heal%%%造成伤害。
shard.en: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for %damage_to_heal%%% of the damage done.

objects.subject: wisp_spirits
objects.description_zh: 召唤五个围绕艾欧起舞的幽魂，对所有碰触到的单位造成伤害。如果碰到的是敌方英雄，幽魂会爆炸，对其附近的所有敌人造成伤害。普通单位碰到幽魂会受到轻微伤害，但是不会使其爆炸。持续时间结束后，幽魂将自动爆炸。
objects.description_en: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
notes_zh: 召唤后艾欧可以拉近或拉远幽魂。

scepter.zh: 每秒被动产生幽魂围绕艾欧，直至数量上限。幽魂撞到英雄会将其短暂减速。可以主动施放来引爆幽魂。
scepter.en: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.

objects.subject: wisp_overcharge
objects.description_zh: 艾欧获得攻击速度、技能增强和基于最大生命值的生命恢复。如果艾欧和一个友军连接，该单位也会获得过载提供的所有增益效果。
objects.description_en: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.

objects.subject: wisp_relocate
objects.description_zh: 将艾欧和与其连接的友军传送到地图上任何位置。持续时间结束后艾欧和相连的友军会被传送回原位。双击将传送回己方的泉水。
objects.description_en: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes_zh: 敌人在施法延迟期间会在大地图和小地图上目标区域都收到视觉特效提示。
如果艾欧在施法延迟期间被控制，降临将会取消。
如果羁绊连接了友方英雄，该英雄将和你一起被传送。你可以随时断开连接，防止英雄和你一同传送。
只有英雄、类英雄单位和幻象可以降临。

objects.subject: wisp_equilibrium
objects.description_zh: 艾欧获得伤害输出增强，血量越高，数值越高。同时，艾欧还获得生命回复和治疗增强，血量越低，数值越高。
objects.description_en: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

objects.subject: visage_gravekeepers_cloak
objects.description_zh: 维萨吉产生数层屏障来保护他，降低受到的伤害。每当他受到来自玩家的伤害，就会失去一层屏障，失去的屏障需要一定时间才能恢复。维萨吉的佣兽在%radius%范围内也会受到斗篷的保护，承伤降低的数值取决于维萨吉拥有的层数。
objects.description_en: Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
notes_zh: 每次维萨吉受到来自其他玩家的伤害超过最小伤害时，保护层就会移除一层。
佣兽在维萨吉周围%radius%范围内将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

shard.zh: 获得主动效果，维萨吉可以化作石像形态，对身边375范围内的敌人造成0.8/1.0/1.2秒眩晕，同时造成60/100/140点伤害，获得6秒无敌状态。最多恢复%shard_hp_restoration_pct%%%生命值。
shard.en: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds.  Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.

objects.subject: visage_silent_as_the_grave
objects.description_zh: 维萨吉获得飞行移动状态和移动速度加成。攻击或施法后，将失去移速加成和飞行移动状态，同时维萨吉和他的佣兽在%bonus_duration%秒内拥有额外攻击力。
objects.description_en: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.

scepter.zh: 移动速度、额外攻击力和持续时间提升。维萨吉和佣兽在持续时间内为隐身状态，直到失去飞行移动状态。
scepter.en: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.

objects.subject: visage_summon_familiars
objects.description_zh:
召唤%familiar_count%只盲眼的佣兽为维萨吉作战。佣兽拥有石像形态技能，可以化为石像，在落地时使敌人眩晕。在石像形态中的佣兽无敌，并且迅速回复生命值。佣兽被击杀时给予高额奖励。

技能可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，在此期间佣兽无法攻击或行动。
objects.description_en:
Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
notes_zh: 施放召唤佣兽后已有的佣兽将会死亡。
佣兽在维萨吉周围时将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果和黄泉颤抖的加成效果。

objects.subject: slark_dark_pact
objects.description_zh:
短暂延迟后，斯拉克牺牲部分生命力，清除大部分负面状态并对自己和周围敌方单位造成伤害。斯拉克自身只受到造成伤害的%self_damage_pct%%%。

驱散类型：强驱散
objects.description_en:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%%% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes_zh: 经过%delay%秒施法延迟后，每隔%pulse_interval%秒释放1道伤害波造成伤害，总共%total_pulses%道。
每道伤害波还会移除斯拉克身上的负面效果。
不能使用此技能自杀。
如果斯拉克死亡，伤害波将停止释放。
